description: Latest company revenue, net income, EPS, operating income, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, capex, free cash flow or shares outstanding from SEC filings. Choose metrics and period (annual, quarterly or ttm). Latest values follow the fiscal year of each company, with the source filing, filing date and accession number for every number.

metrics.description: Comma separated: revenue, net_income, eps_basic, eps_diluted, operating_income, total_assets, total_liabilities, equity, cash, operating_cash_flow, capex, free_cash_flow, shares_outstanding, revenue_contract

period.description: annual, quarterly or ttm (trailing twelve months)

ticker.description: Stock ticker, for example AAPL or BRK.B

name: get_fundamentals
title: Latest values of chosen metrics
